experimental_design: Comparison of four anti-HER2 treatments (trastuzumab, ARRY-380, combination A+T, and DARPin 6L1G) and DMSO control at 6 and 48 hours

BT474 cells were treated in biological duplicates with 100 nM trastuzumab, 100 nM DARPin 6L1G, 10 μM HER2 inhibitor ARRY-380 and the combination of 100 nM trastuzumab and 10 μM ARRY-380, each treatment for 6 and 48 hours.
factor_value: treatment (DMSO, trastuzumab, DARPin 6L1G, ARRY-380, A+T combination), time (6h, 48h)
number_of_biological_replicates: BT474 cells were treated in biological duplicates
